Run a thorough review of recent changes.

Interactive mode (default): Launches a Claude Code session for collaborative review.
Non-interactive mode (--non-interactive): Runs autonomously, creates beads for issues found.

Scope options:
  --since <commit>   Review from a specific commit
  --spec <name>      Review changes from a spec's beads
  --epic <id>        Review changes from an epic's beads
  (default)          Review since last thorough review

Usage:
  gromit review [flags]

Flags:
      --agent string      Override the agent to use for interactive review
      --choose-agent      Show picker to select agent for interactive review
      --dry-run           Preview what would be reviewed
      --epic string       Review changes from this epic's beads
  -h, --help              help for review
      --non-interactive   Run review autonomously without interactive session
      --since string      Review from this commit
      --spec string       Review changes from this spec's beads

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   Path to config file (default "gromit.yaml")
